rationale: Evidence vote is not_defect (same-schema duplicate create returning 200 is explicitly contract-sanctioned and maintainer-confirmed by design), so severity sits at the ladder floor trivial; under the rules, collections/create is a management-plane endpoint (Rule 2 unchanged), no batch amplification applies (Rule 3), doc_verification_result=DOC_PARTIAL (Rule 4 -1) and single-script trigger (Rule 5 -1) only push further down, and no crash signals exist for the Rule 4 forced-Critical exception.
